text: Wellness Sanctuary & Holistic Spa Resort | Kamalaya Koh Samui WELCOME TO KAMALAYA THE REALM OF THE LOTUS Kamalaya offers holistic health solutions to the anxiety, stress and numerous other challenges posed by the ever-changing world around us. Imagine a place where you can reconnect with your inner self and rejuvenate your mind, body and spirit surrounded by nature. Experience our unique approach to wellness which combines ancient Eastern healing traditions with Western medical research to achieve life-enhancing results. DETAILS From 1 to 30 November 2022, we are working on enhancements to make your experience even more memorable. DETAILS WELLNESS PROGRAMS Kamalaya’s innovative philosophy to wellness supports holistic healing from the inside out. Flexibility and fluidity are at the heart of our offerings, inviting you to listen to your intuition as you seek internal harmony. Every individual who walks through our doors has unique needs, and at Kamalaya, we provide the time, space, and support to help you define and refine your personal wellness journey. We believe that all aspects of health are interconnected. Our programs are therefore enriched by the expertise of Naturopaths, Traditional Chinese Medicine practitioners, Yoga teachers, fitness trainers, massage therapists, Meditation and Life Enhancement Mentors, and a variety of other complementary health professionals. EXPLORE WELLNESS PROGRAMS FIND YOUR ACCOMMODATION TRANQUIL HAVENS FOR YOUR TRANSFORMATION At Kamalaya, we offer 76 thoughtfully designed rooms, suites, and villas, each harmoniously integrated into the natural landscape of granite boulders, lush forest canopies, and sweeping sea views. Many of our accommodations feature breathtaking views overlooking the verdant jungle or Koh Samui’s turquoise waters, nestled in the Gulf of Thailand. Transcending a traditional spa retreat, Kamalaya is a sanctuary for the soul, where every detail – from the architecture to the cuisine – invites profound rest, rejuvenation, and a deep reconnection with your true self. Located within the tranquil natural surroundings of Kamalaya’s Wellness Sanctuary, this new addition facility offers forward-thinking supplementary treatments to support you on your wellbeing journey. Guests can choose treatments from IV Therapy, Ozone Therapy and Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy elevated by binaural sound healing. LEARN MORE DISCOVER WELLNESS Enhance your wellbeing at Kamalaya Wellness Sanctuary, where we seamlessly blend healing practices from both the East and West. Our extensive menu features over a hundred therapies and treatments, each designed to support your journey to balance and vitality. Additionally, our optional daily classes are open to all guests, offering a diverse range of experiences from Pilates, yoga, and Qi Gong, to meditation, Tai Chi, and core fitness – all designed to cultivate inner harmony and rejuvenation. EXPLORE WELLNESS DISCOVER THE POWER OF COGNITIVE WELLNESS Cognitive health is the key to clarity, resilience and long-term wellbeing. At Kamalaya’s Cognitive House, we blend cutting-edge therapies with ancient healing traditions to support memory, focus and mental performance. By nurturing the brain-heart connection, we help you cultivate balance, reduce mental fatigue and unlock your full potential. Whether you’re looking to enhance cognitive function or find inner calm, this transformative approach to brain health offers a path to greater vitality and clarity. LEARN MORE MEET KAMALAYA’S WELLNESS GUARDIANS Introducing Kamalaya’s Wellness Guardians, your personal champions on the path to lifelong wellness. Available across various time zones, our Wellness Guardians provide personalised support and guidance tailored to your unique needs. With a commitment to holistic wellbeing, they ensure seamless care before, during and after your stay, enhancing your journey to true wellness. LEARN MORE DIAGNOSTICS & FUNCTIONAL ASSESSMENTS With a continuous focus on longevity, guests at Kamalaya can support their wellness through comprehensive diagnostics, functional health assessments and preventive screenings. By gaining insights into potential illnesses before they manifest, we empower you to prevent health disorders and extend your lifespan. Our dedicated team guides your individual journey, helping you achieve transformative results for optimal health and wellbeing. LEARN MORE MONTHLY ONLINE LIVE WORKSHOPS SATURDAY, 26 July, 2025, 4:30 PM (GMT +7) SIGN UP TODAY FOR FREE 60 MINUTES LIVE WORKSHOP Join us for an engaging wellness workshop where we delve into the real root causes of modern-day burnout, its effects on the body, and how to recognize the subtle signs before they escalate. SIGN UP NOW DIGITAL DETOX We encourage you to abandon the regular use of digital devices to ensure that you and your fellow guests are able to disconnect from the outside world and fully immerse in a wellness program. We kindly request you to not use mobiles, laptops, tablets or other digital devices, except e-books, in public areas of tranquillity. All guests receive a complimentary journal to jot down any flashes of inspiration that manifest whilst relaxing on the beach, dining in our restaurants or strolling around our expansive tropical gardens. Guests are more than welcome to use digital devices in the privacy of their own rooms or in the Library, where complimentary WiFi is available. KAMALAYA COLLECTIVE Welcome to our online wellness library, where you are encouraged to explore our extensive collection of life-enhancing videos, blogs, health tips and delicious recipes to remind you of Kamalaya! Whether you are looking for ways to get a more restful night’s sleep, fine-tune your nutrition, or listen to a relaxing audio meditation, you should find some valuable tools here that will help you pursue your wellness goals. DISCOVER KAMALAYA "WELLNESS FOR LIFE" PODCAST NOW ON APPLE & SPOTIFY The Kamalaya podcast is hosted by Karina Stewart, founder and Chief Wellness Officer at Kamalaya Koh Samui, the multi-award-winning wellness sanctuary and holistic spa in southern Thailand, Asia. Karina invites you to join her for this ongoing series of warm and open conversations with experts, practitioners and innovators from the world of holistic health and wellbeing.
